page_title: UDI 0-2 TOR | Udinese v Torino 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The opposition back off Isaac Success (Udinese) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
90+2' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Saba Sazonov (Torino) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
83' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Raoul Bellanova and he is replaced by Valentino Lazaro (Torino).
83' That's the end of the game for Alessandro Buongiorno, who is replaced by Saba Sazonov (Torino).
82' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
82' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
79' The ball possession at the moment is 44:56.
76' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Roberto Pereyra is replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
73' Duvan Zapata (Torino) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye is alert and denies him.
70' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Okereke leaves the pitch and Antonio Sanabria (Torino) comes on.
65' It is time for a substitution. Matteo Lovato (Torino) is on for Mergim Vojvoda.
64' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
59' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to make a change. Festy Ebosele (Udinese) replaces Kingsley Ehizibue.
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Hassane Kamara as he is replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
58' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
57' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic easily deals with the threat.
53' 0 - 2 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
52' What was Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
49' It looks like Samuele Ricci (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Andrea Colombo won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' It will be a substitution. Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Joao Ferreira walks off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
43' Walace (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
39' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Florian Thauvin (Udinese).
38' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
37' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

36' A cross from Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
34' 1:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
31' Substitution. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) replaces Roberto Pereyra.
29' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

29' David Okereke (Torino) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Andrea Colombo couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) and blew his whistle.
27' Torino enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
25' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
20' Torino take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' Duvan Zapata (Torino) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' Duvan Zapata (Torino) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
13' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
10' 0 - 1 Duvan Zapata (Torino) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
10' The linesman raises his flag for offside before David Okereke (Torino) heads on.
8' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
6' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
5' An attempted cross from David Okereke (Torino) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Torino.
4' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

3' Duvan Zapata (Torino) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Duvan Zapata (Torino) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The linesman makes the right call and Torino will have a corner.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
